description: Helm chart for pr-generator — deploys the automated PR creation daemon on Kubernetes. Supports GitHub App and PAT authentication, Bitbucket Cloud, multi-provider setups, and optional ServiceAccount/PDB creation.
rules: The chart enforces replicas: 1 — do not increase; the application has no distributed coordination
Provider names 'github' and 'bitbucket' auto-infer their type; all other names require an explicit type field
Each Bitbucket or GitHub PAT provider must use a unique tokenEnv value to avoid credential collisions
config.rules requires minItems: 1 — the chart will not install without at least one rule
Use secrets.github.existingSecret / secrets.bitbucket.existingSecret for production; inline secrets are for dev/test only
serviceAccount.create defaults to true; set to false and provide a name to use an existing ServiceAccount
startupProbe is empty by default (opt-in); enable it when the app needs extra time on first boot to resolve the GitHub App installation ID
The chart version must be bumped on every change to charts/pr-generator/
